objective: Implement explicit evidence-linked finding lifecycle transitions in the local journal with immutable history, predecessor checks, scoped verification and recorded review, not automatic approval.
request_basis: User agreed to evidence -> proposed regression -> authorized repair -> verification/review, then explicitly requested implementation of reported/reproduced/fix_proposed/verified_local/reviewed_closed finding lifecycle.
acceptance: Implement explicit forward lifecycle with append-only transition events and atomic expected-predecessor checks; preserve old v1 events without migration/reset or automatic promotion.

Each transition pins evidence and acting run; verified_local requires same repair run successful verify and current source/checker fingerprints, reviewed_closed additionally requires recorded review; actor/reviewer labels are not authenticated signoff.
Read-only history/report/suggestions show lifecycle separately from original reported outcome and do not auto-close from PASS; duplicate/conflicting/stale/concurrent calls do not overwrite history.

Focused synthetic tests cover legal sequence, skipped states, stale predecessor/verification, evidence requirements, reviewer metadata, duplicates/concurrency and rollback on failure; no real finding is falsely closed for demonstration.
Preserve unrelated edits, current plan/state and product gate; no new runtime, arbitrary commands, models, installations or historical generators.
